description: Monitors perpetual funding rates and takes opposite positions on Coinbase spot when rates become extreme. Captures basis convergence opportunities systematically.
Dollar cost averages into BTC or ETH on Coinbase with weekly or monthly intervals. Adjusts buy amounts based on volatility and account balance.
Buys when RSI drops below 30 on 4-hour Coinbase charts. Exits when RSI recovers above 70.
Enters long when price crosses above 20-period MA on 15-minute charts. Quick exits on opposite crossover.
Triggers buy orders when price breaks above 24-hour high with increased volume. Captures momentum moves on Coinbase trading pairs. Includes trailing stops.
Places multiple buy and sell orders at predetermined intervals around current price. Profits from sideways movement on Coinbase. Automatically rebalances grid levels.
Follows Supertrend indicator signals on daily charts for Coinbase positions. Stays in trends longer while filtering out noise.
Buys near lower Bollinger Band and sells near upper band on 1-hour Coinbase charts. Exploits price extremes in ranging markets.
Enters positions when MACD histogram shows expanding momentum on 4-hour timeframes. Exits on histogram contraction.
Identifies key support levels on Coinbase charts and buys on bounces with confirmation. Sells at resistance zones.
